title: StaySmall
description: A Lightweight plugin to keep your mobs small and cute forever!
body:
---

# 🍼 StaySmall – Keep 'em Cute Forever

Have you ever tamed the *perfect* baby wolf, or discovered the *cutest* baby cow… only to watch it grow up when you weren't looking?
**StaySmall** solves that problem with **one tiny Name Tag**.

---

## 🔧 How It Works

1. **Rename** a Name Tag in an anvil — by default, call it **staybaby**
2. **Right-click** any baby mob with the tag
   • *Poof!* It will never grow up
3. *(Optional)* Rename another tag to **makebaby** and bonk an adult mob to shrink it down!

---

## 💖 Why You'll Love It

* **Perfect for Zoos & Pet Shops** – keep exhibits tiny without world-editing
* **Player-Friendly** – anyone can use it, no permissions needed
* **Lag-Free** – feather-light, doesn’t run every tick
* **Works Everywhere** – Paper, Purpur, Spigot, Folia... from 1.13+ to latest snapshots
* **Fully Customisable** – change keywords, hide/show names, toggle tag consumption — all in `config.yml`

---

## ⚙️ Quick Setup

1. Drop `StaySmall.jar` into your `plugins/` folder
2. Restart the server
3. Edit `plugins/StaySmall/config.yml` if you'd like to change keywords or behavior
4. Run `/staysmall reload` (or restart) to apply changes

---

**Enjoy your forever-tiny friends!**
